concepts.gloss_en: The Tablets (of the Covenant), length and breadth six — the aspect of the letter vav

reason_for_human: All five occurrences vocalize as לוּחוֹת/הַלּוּחוֹת and unambiguously refer to the same Tablets of the Covenant (Bava Batra 14a: length six, breadth six; broken Tablets; 'write on the tablet of your heart'). The definite-article difference is just inflection/context, not an archetype-vs-generic split — every instance denotes the one specific pair of Tablets. Safe merge.
